description: Phase 2 microcampaign to test the best audited layout/transpiler seed for the residual g0 k=2 bias.
rationale: The accepted Phase 1 g0 opt2 repeat reduced the k=2 anomaly but still measured p_hat=0.297363, with absolute deviation 0.047363.
The Phase 2 layout audit identified optimization_level=2 and transpiler_seed=67890 as the best g0 k=2 candidate, with noisy simulated p=0.258545 and absolute deviation 0.008545.
The candidate has the same two-qubit count as the accepted Phase 1 g0 k=2 circuit and only a small depth increase from 71 to 76.
The campaign repeats g0 k=0 as a fresh calibration anchor and g0 k=2 as the sensitive circuit.

selected_jobs.purpose: Test audited transpiler seed 67890 for the residual g0 k=2 bias.

stopping_rules: Prepare without --submit and confirm g0 k=2 is close to depth 76 and 19 two-qubit gates.
Submit only these two circuits; do not combine with g1 or g2 because those Phase 1 results are already strong.
If g0 k=2 remains in the watch region, move next to mitigation rather than more random seed searches.
